pipelines.label: Dense ∥ BM25 → RRF → cross-encoder
pipelines.note: The default. Two retrievers vote, a cross-encoder reads the shortlist against the query, the gate decides.

pipelines.label: Dense ∥ BM25 → RRF
pipelines.note: The same without the cross-encoder. Fused rank is bounded, so the gate still has a scale to work against.

pipelines.label: MiniLM embeddings only
pipelines.note: No gate. Cosine similarity is bounded, but bounded is not the same as discriminating: over 250 golden queries a correct top hit scored median 0.851 and a wrong one 0.771, with ranges that overlap almost completely. A threshold there would abstain by accident.

pipelines.label: BM25 lexical only
pipelines.note: No gate: BM25 scores are unbounded and scale with query length, so no fixed threshold means the same thing across queries.

pipelines.label: Hybrid + co-citation neighbours
pipelines.note: GraphRAG in the honest sense: the candidate set is widened by what real tenders cite alongside the top hits, not by a model.

pipelines.label: Local model, no retrieval
pipelines.note: The baseline that shows why the rest exists. Measured only when Ollama is running; never estimated.
pipelines.why_not_measured: No Ollama server at http://localhost:11434. Clauses are composed from the template.

note: Every pipeline ran the same queries against the same register. Abstention is reported only where the score is calibrated enough to decline on. Answers outside the register are zero for retrieval pipelines by construction, not by care.
